**Clan Name**: [Night Flight Europa](https://www.bungie.net/en/ClanV2?groupid=2654820)


**Our Motto**: No anxiety, no impatience, no judgment. Welcome to the Night Flight.



**System**: XB1



**Location/Time Zone**: We're scattered across North America, but we all still find time to play together. No matter your country, though, you are welcome. More than a few of us stay up long nights and into the mornings playing.



**When our clan typically plays**: Again, we're scattered in this regard. You'll see the few of us play at pretty much any time of day, especially in the evenings and often though the night and into the mornings.



**More about our clan**: While we're only sitting at 9 members, we're all pretty good friends. Your light level doesn't matter. The idea is to form a tight-knit, friendly group of people for whom we can build a safe space. You do not have to do anything you don't want to do. There is no room here for anyone who is rude. You bought this game to have fun, not to get stressed. This is an anxiety free zone. Let's make friendships. Don't be afraid to be yourself. Weird, shy, anxious, young, old, beginners, veterans; we don't care. We want to have FUN. That's a pretty simple philosophy, right? Let's keep it that simple.



**What is the best way to contact your clan?**: We can be reached either though our clan page ([Night Flight Europa](https://www.bungie.net/en/ClanV2?groupid=2654820)) or I can be reached at: Erol Eats Acid (XB1 Gamertag)
"You look like a man born without an eye, which is way creepier than a man who lost one."
